Every meaning is the English Wiktionary's (kaikki.org), every sentence a Tatoeba sentence named by id, every rule of grammar a sentence or cell of the Wikipedia revision its `why` names.

since a list of word forms ranks книгу above книга. 49 more were added by hand in November 2026, after a beginner's audit of the shelf: 28 words no deck taught — весь, так, такой, себя, чем, просто, конечно and others that the frequency rule had turned away as forms of other words, and five courtesies — each built from the same sources, 13 numbers from thirteen to ninety moved up from A2, and 8 phrases of a first exchange (как вас зовут, я не понимаю, сколько это стоит) moved up from the phrases deck. That these 49 are Elementary material is a judgement, not a citation. THE ORDER is a teaching one: the first 136 notes are laid out by hand — the courtesies, a first exchange, the pronouns, ten verbs, the question words, zero to ten, the commonest function words — and after them the words come by frequency, with the days of the week together from note 151, the numbers above ten from note 201, the colours from note 251 and the months and the seasons from note 301. At the default of ten new cards a day, both directions together, that is five words a day: привет on day one, the pronouns by day 6, and the whole deck in 110 days.
